reviewed_new_code.method: measured_requirement = G_move - (S * (1 + ratio) + slack), measured by tools/architecture/net_move.py at recorded_at_revision with base origin/3.4.3 (merge-base 24a513855e): S = 66404, G_move = 100222, ratio and slack credits = 66404 * 0.05 + 300 = 3620.2, so the requirement is 100222 - 70024.2 = 30197.8 and the reviewed budget above is that figure rounded up. Growth outside the destination roots (tooling, documentation, test trees, other crates) is reported as accounted growth and is not charged.

phases.note: Core hub scaffolding (SessionCore, HubRef/HubMut, canonical access) is written before the wow-world bodies are deleted.
Largest phase: the application/lifecycle/spell/inventory owners plus their Cx, host-trait, controller and projection surfaces are new code; only the moved bodies are offset by the shrink.

phases.phase: post-pause (969bee686..HEAD, migrations plus the rustfmt pass)
phases.note: F5 registrars (social inspect, lifecycle account-data, application reputation) and the F6 retirements were net moves; the rustfmt normalization of the branch's own sources reflowed long lines and the new host adapter/composer calls add their own lines, which is most of this phase's new_code.

areas.reason: SessionCore/hub state, canonical access owners, map-manager runtime and host traits; new types and cfg-gated fixture refs, not copies of the wow-world remainder.

admitted application owners with their Cx/controller/projection types (quest, loot release, trainer purchase, inventory valuation, aura removal) plus the F5 handler families hosted there (bank, equipment-set use, instances, reputation).
inventory owners, storage/adapter and publication surfaces extracted from the wow-world item handlers.
lifecycle state, load/finalization owners and account-data handlers.
spell state, melee rules and spell-acquisition adapters.
loot state, roll publication and random properties.
social group/duel state plus the inspect handler family and group fanout.

Re-measure and re-record this budget whenever destination growth changes; unbudgeted growth fails R1.
